owner.instructions: This is one thread from the support@muso.ai inbox. Judge who owns FIRST CONTACT with it, under the muso-support-email-triage doctrine: does Caroline's support-skill/KB tooling resolve it, does it structurally require a human to read the raw email first, or is it not a support request at all? Filing a ticket or running a gated self-service write is Caroline owning the thread, not a human handoff.

criteria.caroline: Any thread whose first contact is a Caroline support skill or KB answer, a gated self-service write (credit verification, credit removal, profile claim/consolidate/dedupe, track dedupe, order/address fix, founding buy-back), or filing the recommend-approve / needs-human / intake ticket her skill is designed to file -- including when she discovers something a human must act on downstream, because she still owned first contact. Default for any genuine customer request.
criteria.human: ONLY a thread Caroline structurally cannot even start, where a human must read the raw email first: legal/rights/IP demands (DMCA, subpoena, cease-and-desist, licensing or chain-of-title disputes, official legal/visa documentation); security/account-compromise/fraud/law-enforcement; pure sales or commercial negotiation (enterprise/full-catalog-API deals, Business-tier quotes); vendor/B2B business development (partnership, data-licensing, press, recruiting, AP invoices); Google de-indexing; formal legal/privacy-rights deletion demands; or a disputed cross-account claim reversal (removing someone else's claim). Needing a write or a ticket is NOT a human trigger.
criteria.spam: Not a support request at all, and no human action either: cold marketing/promotions, SEO/link-building pitches, unsolicited app/TestFlight invites, newsletters, or automated system noise (mailer-daemon/delivery-failure bounces, auto-replies, out-of-office, read receipts, list confirmations, automated request-received receipts, internal test mail, Intercom/tooling setup notices).

category.instructions: Same thread as the owner question. Pick the single category that best names what the sender wants, drawn from the same doctrine used to decide owner.

criteria.credit-verification: Caroline: a pending/stuck credit submission ('user verification needed') -- she verifies ownership and reviews proof.
criteria.credit-removal: Caroline: the customer wants a mechanical wrong credit removed from a profile they own.
criteria.profile-claim-consolidate-dedupe: Caroline: claiming a profile, merging the customer's own duplicate profiles, or deduping profiles.
criteria.refund-cancellation: Caroline: a refund or subscription-cancellation request, handled through the refund-retention 3-gate flow.
criteria.analytics-streams-issue: Caroline: analytics/streams genuinely appear off; she files the analytics-followup data-integrity ticket herself.
criteria.profile-data-correction: Caroline: a correction to the customer's own profile data.
criteria.order-plaque-fulfillment: Caroline: an order, plaque, or Prodigi fulfillment question, including an address fix on an editable order.
criteria.founding-member-qa-buyback: Caroline: founding-member Q&A or a paid buy-back checkout link.
criteria.account-email-change: Caroline: the customer wants to change the email on their own Muso account.
criteria.account-profile-deletion: Caroline: account or profile deletion/removal intake for the customer's own account/profile.
criteria.general-howto-faq: Caroline: a general how-to or FAQ question answerable from the KB.
criteria.caroline-filed-needs-human: Caroline: she owned first contact but the substance is something she cannot finish herself and files a needs-human ticket (e.g. a credit-theft contradiction she discovered, or a cross-owner merge).
criteria.legal-rights-ip: Human: DMCA, subpoena, cease-and-desist, licensing or chain-of-title dispute, or official legal/visa documentation.
criteria.security-fraud-compromise: Human: account compromise, fraud, law-enforcement request, or a security event on the support mailbox itself.
criteria.sales-commercial: Human: pure sales or commercial negotiation -- enterprise/full-catalog-API deals, Business-tier quotes.
criteria.vendor-b2b: Human: vendor/B2B business development -- partnership, data-licensing, press, recruiting, AP invoices.
criteria.legal-privacy-deletion-demand: Human: a formal legal/privacy-rights deletion demand (as opposed to the customer's own account-deletion intake, which is Caroline's).
criteria.disputed-cross-account-claim: Human: a disputed cross-account claim reversal -- removing SOMEONE ELSE'S claim.
criteria.cold-marketing-promo: Spam: cold marketing or a promotion.
criteria.seo-link-building: Spam: an SEO or link-building pitch.
criteria.unsolicited-app-invite: Spam: an unsolicited app or TestFlight invite.
criteria.system-noise: Spam: automated system noise -- mailer-daemon/delivery-failure bounces, auto-replies, out-of-office, read receipts, list confirmations, automated request-received receipts, internal test mail, Intercom/tooling setup notices.
